title: Halcyon Bay
verdict: A complete harbour town built in half the time: named streets, working traffic lights, courier jobs, a race and a wanted level all function. It looks plainer than Port Vesper, with boxier cars and flatter buildings.

city.note: Six-by-six grid of named streets with crossings, about 60 buildings in three styles, a park, a fountain plaza, and a promenade with a pier and lighthouse.

character.note: Blocky jointed figure with walk, run and jump animations; steps up onto low objects. Solid collisions.

vehicles.note: Seven car models, parked or carjacked from AI drivers (checked with a police cruiser). Drifts, skid marks, collisions. Models are simple boxes.

world.note: 26 AI cars and 2 police patrols obeying traffic lights, and 44 pedestrians who flee speeding cars.

hud.note: Rotating minimap, dial speedometer with gear, clock, cash, wanted stars, and the current street and district name.

gameplay.note: Timed courier job paid $516 when completed, with fragile cargo that loses value in crashes; 12-checkpoint race started; stealing a cruiser gave 2 wanted stars.

atmosphere.note: Seven-minute day and night with stars, street-lamp pools, headlights, a lighthouse beam and a rippling sea. Flatter lighting, no post-processing. Sound not listened to.
